title: Receive reunion without forgetting the Doer
summary: This meets the heart that wants to claim return as its own achievement. The line teaches reunion under the Lord's pleasure because the Creator is still the Doer.
takeaway: Receive reunion under the Lord's pleasure.
lifeApplication: When what was absent finally returns, pause before telling the success story. Receive the reunion under the Lord's pleasure, then thank the Creator who did it.

source.shortMeaning: Reunion is received under the Lord's pleasure and the Creator's doing.
source.lifeApplication: When reunion comes, receive it under the Lord's pleasure before claiming it.

evidence.coreClaim: Reunion is received under the Lord's pleasure and the Creator's doing.
evidence.turn: Learn to receive under the Lord's pleasure rather than argue with it.
evidence.practicalImplication: When what was absent finally returns, pause before telling the success story. Receive the reunion under the Lord's pleasure, then thank the Creator who did it.
